description: Build the tournament detail admin page and its TournamentDetailPanel client component. This is the main gap: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId]/page.tsx currently does not exist. The page is a server component that fetches tournament data via the existing GET /api/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId] Prisma query pattern (directly with Prisma, same as other admin pages), then renders a new TournamentDetailPanel client component. Depends on FEAT-001 being committed first (the registrations API route must exist so TypeScript does not complain about the fetch URL).
steps: Create apps/web/src/components/admin/TournamentDetailPanel.tsx as a 'use client' component. Props: { guildId: string, tournament: TournamentDetail } where TournamentDetail is a local interface covering all fields returned by the admin GET endpoint (id, name, description, game, mode, status, entryType, entryPrice, teamCapacity, acceptedCount, rosterMin, rosterMax, substituteAllowed, waitlistEnabled, autoApprove, registrationFormat, mapPool, bannerUrl, rulesUrl, visibility, registrationOpenAt, registrationCloseAt, checkInOpenAt, checkInCloseAt, startAt, endAt, completedAt, cancelledAt, stages (with matches), registrations (with team)). All date fields are strings (ISO) or null.

Inside TournamentDetailPanel, implement 4 tabs using @radix-ui/react-tabs (already installed). Tab values: 'overview', 'registrations', 'matches', 'settings'. Follow the exact tab pattern used in ParticipantsTable.tsx (Tabs.Root + Tabs.List with Tabs.Trigger + Tabs.Content per tab).

Overview tab content: A GlassCard showing tournament metadata grid (name, game, mode, status as Badge, entryType, capacity bar like TournamentAdminTable, key dates formatted with toLocaleDateString en-IN). Below the grid, render action buttons based on status: (a) status==='DRAFT' → GlowButton variant='primary' 'Publish Tournament' calls POST /api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/publish then router.refresh(); (b) status!=='CANCELLED' && status!=='COMPLETED' && status!=='ARCHIVED' → GlowButton variant='destructive' 'Cancel Tournament' opens an inline reason textarea (same pattern as ReasonModal in ParticipantsTable.tsx) then calls POST /api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/cancel with {reason}, then router.refresh(); (c) status==='LIVE' → GlowButton variant='ghost' 'Finalize →' links via router.push to /servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId]/finalize. All API calls use toast from sonner for success/error feedback.

Registrations tab content: Embed the existing ParticipantsTable component (import from '@/components/admin/ParticipantsTable'). Pass guildId, tournamentId, and initialData (serialize registrations from the tournament prop into RegistrationRow[]). ParticipantsTable already handles approve/reject via PATCH /api/servers/[guildId]/registrations/[registrationId] — do NOT change that component's fetch URL; it already works. The FEAT-001 route is an additional admin-namespaced alias, not a replacement.

Matches tab content: A GlassCard with a paragraph explaining matches are managed per-tournament. Add a GlowButton 'Open Match Scheduler' that calls router.push(`/servers/${guildId}/admin/tournaments/${tournamentId}/matches`). Also show a read-only summary table of existing stages+matches from tournament.stages (stage name, match count, first scheduled start) using the same table styling as MatchSchedulerPanel.tsx (thead/tbody, px-4 py-3, border-b border-white/10 rows).

Settings tab content: An inline edit form using react-hook-form (already installed). Fields: name (text, min 3 max 100), description (textarea, max 500), visibility (select: public/members_only), teamCapacity (number), rosterMin (number), rosterMax (number), registrationOpenAt (datetime-local), registrationCloseAt (datetime-local), checkInOpenAt (datetime-local), checkInCloseAt (datetime-local), startAt (datetime-local), endAt (datetime-local). On submit, PATCH /api/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId] with the changed fields. Serialize datetime-local values to ISO strings before sending. Show toast on success/error. Use the same input styling as in tournament-wizard/Step3Schedule.tsx (rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-violet-500/50).

Create apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId]/page.tsx as an async server component. Import pattern: same as participants/page.tsx — createClient from @/lib/supabase/server, resolveUserRole + AppRole from @esports/permissions, prisma from @esports/database, redirect from next/navigation. Auth guard: require TOURNAMENT_MANAGER. Fetch: prisma.tournament.findFirst({ where: { id: tournamentId, guildId }, include: { stages: { orderBy: { order: 'asc' }, include: { matches: { orderBy: { number: 'asc' }, select: { id, number, status, scheduledStart, scheduledEnd, map, mode } } } }, registrations: { select: { id, status, createdAt, approvedAt, rejectionReason, slotNumber, team: { select: { name, tag } }, _count: { select: { members: true } } }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } } } }). Serialize all Date fields to ISO strings. Pass to TournamentDetailPanel.
Add `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` to the page file.
acceptance_criteria: apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId]/page.tsx exists and is a valid Next.js server component.
apps/web/src/components/admin/TournamentDetailPanel.tsx exists with 4 tabs: overview, registrations, matches, settings.
The Overview tab shows tournament metadata and conditionally renders Publish, Cancel, and Finalize action buttons.
The Registrations tab renders ParticipantsTable with the tournament's registrations.
The Settings tab renders a react-hook-form that PATCHes the admin tournament endpoint on submit.
Running `npm run type-check` in apps/web exits 0.
Running `npm run lint` in apps/web exits 0.
findings: Created apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId]/page.tsx as an async server component with export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'. Auth guard requires AppRole.TOURNAMENT_MANAGER. Fetches tournament via prisma.tournament.findFirst with stages+matches and registrations. Serializes Prisma Decimal (entryPrice) via .toNumber(), JsonValue (mapPool) via Array.isArray cast, and all Date fields via .toISOString(). Passes serialized data to TournamentDetailPanel. Created apps/web/src/components/admin/TournamentDetailPanel.tsx as 'use client' component with TournamentDetail interface. Implements 4 tabs using @radix-ui/react-tabs (overview, registrations, matches, settings). Overview tab: GlassCard metadata grid with capacity progress bar, Badge for status, formatted dates; action buttons conditionally render Publish (DRAFT), Cancel (non-terminal), and Finalize (LIVE); Cancel uses inline textarea panel matching ReasonModal pattern. Registrations tab: embeds ParticipantsTable unchanged with serialized registrations as RegistrationRow[]. Matches tab: description paragraph + Open Match Scheduler GlowButton + read-only stages summary table. Settings tab: react-hook-form with all required fields, datetime-local values serialized to ISO on submit, PATCHes /api/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId]. Toast feedback on all API calls. npm run type-check and npm run lint both exit 0.
